administration: Frappe Desk > JoyMedia > Partner access, or Manage reviewers on the administrator project page
setup: Create a Website User account for the partner.
Create Partner Access for that User; saving assigns JoyMedia Reviewer automatically.
Add exact full-video or scene Asset Versions and partner-facing titles. New versions remain private.
Optionally allow feedback, the download action, and generation testing within explicit limits.
default: Review-only, no generation, no administrator workspaces or shared library.
scope: Each partner sees only their own feedback and administrator responses, on published versions.
sandbox: When enabled, partner-owned projects only. Lifetime project cap, video duration and resolution caps, transactionally counted Generation Attempts including retries. Worker validation enforces revocation before submission.
revocation: Remove a published version or disable account access. Every new playback, feedback and download request checks the current grant. Already delivered bytes cannot be revoked.
download: Controls the download action; playback necessarily delivers video bytes.
media: Authenticated streaming supports byte ranges and uses private no-store caching.
